privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.item1_desc: When using login or filling in your BYODB credentials, we only collect essential data (name, email, and infrastructure keys) for authentication and system technical operation purposes.
privacy.item2_desc: Your data is used exclusively to authenticate your access, synchronize your records privately within your own structure (Supabase), and allow interaction with the engine's Artificial Intelligence.
privacy.item3_desc: Important: Your API keys and sensitive metadata are managed locally by the CLI Agent and are never sent to our central servers. This ensures total sovereignty over your data.
privacy.item4_desc: We only use strictly necessary cookies to keep your session active and save your theme preferences (Dark Mode). All communication is encrypted via TLS 1.3.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.item1_desc: By accessing this application, you agree to comply with these terms of service and all applicable laws regarding development and data protection (LGPD).
terms.item2_desc: MetaBuilderPRO is an automation and technical aid tool. Architecture decisions and final implementation must be mandatory reviewed by a responsible human developer.
terms.item3_desc: Access is personal and non-transferable. The user is solely responsible for the security of their API keys and database credentials (Bring Your Own Database).
terms.item4_desc: All MetaBuilderPRO design and branding are owned by AGTech. The code generated by the engine in your infrastructure remains in your possession and responsibility.

hero.badge: The Software Engine of the Future
hero.title: Systems
hero.subtitle: with the speed your business demands
hero.desc: Accelerate your technical delivery with MetaBuilderPRO. Connect legacy databases, use Metadata Intelligence to structure premium interfaces, and manage multiple projects in a whitelabel platform with native, secure and highly scalable Next.js backend.

home.bento_desc: Forget boilerplate. Focus on what matters: your client's business logic.
home.bridge_desc: MetaBuilderPRO connects to your current SQL database and generates a complete administrative interface in minutes, without touching a single line of your current structure.
home.zero_trust_desc: Unlike other tools, MetaBuilderPRO doesn't connect to your database. It sends encrypted commands to your local tunnel, which processes the information.
home.control_center_desc: Complete management panel: per-DEV productivity metrics, billing, subscription, the iClub loyalty program, the MetaVoice suggestion channel, and an integrated community focused on collective engagement and performance improvement.
home.control_center_desc_long: The Control Center is the technical manager's cockpit. Monitor development sessions in real-time, audit actions with timeline granularity, manage your subscription, interact with suggestions on MetaVoice, and track iClub benefits — all in one panel.
home.control_center_sub_bi_desc: Monitor billing, track active development time for each developer, analyze Cycle Time, and generate real-time analytical reports for strategic decision-making.
home.control_center_sub_billing_desc: Offer full autonomy for customers to manage Stripe invoices, update payment methods, switch subscription plans, and perform transparent self-service cancellations.
home.control_center_sub_community_desc: An integrated Social HUB to connect developers, founders, and platform partners. Allows real-time chat interactions, knowledge sharing, and building networking connections.
home.control_center_sub_metavoice_desc: A centralized channel for active feedback and product improvement suggestions. Users submit ideas, vote on the most relevant ones, and track the development roadmap openly.
home.control_center_sub_iclub_desc: The ultimate platform-integrated loyalty program. Offer exclusive benefits, discounts on new licenses, points for platform activities, and gamification to engage your customer base.
home.wizard_desc: Don't waste time drawing grids and forms one by one. Our intelligent assistant creates complete CRUD, Master-Detail, and Dashboard flows based on your database semantics.
home.whitelabel_desc: MetaBuilderPRO disappears so your brand can shine. Dynamic favicons, custom URLs, and specific themes for each project you host on the platform.
home.cta_desc: Accelerate your technical delivery and delight your clients with premium interfaces.
home.sync_desc: Renamed a table in your legacy database? Deleted a column? MetaBuilder automatically detects changes and allows you to remap all your use cases, filters, charts, and BPM automations with a single click. No manual refactoring required.
home.bpm_desc: Create complex business logic by drawing visual diagrams. Synchronize buttons on your interface directly with invisible background flows. All perfectly integrated.
home.pricing_subtitle: Choose the number of licenses and save with progressive volume discounts and renewal terms.
home.pricing_calc_subtitle: Drag the slider to set the number of licenses for your team.
home.ide_desc: Forget cloud limitations. Our native IDE provides absolute control with BYOC (Bring Your Own Code), Integrated Terminal, advanced local SQL Studio, and full source code Ejection.
home.ai_desc: Accelerate your development 100x. Just describe what you need in natural language and the configured AI writes production-ready React code with forms, grids, and interactive panels.
home.git_title: Develop without fear of losing your code.
home.git_desc: MetaBuilder PRO uses an Invisible 3-Branch Architecture. All AI-generated code is tested in an isolated Sandbox before touching your local work.

speed.title: Develop. at the speed of thought.
speed.desc: MetaBuilderPRO was designed to eliminate repetitive web development tasks.
speed.item1_desc: Configure forms, grids, and filters by answering simple questions.
speed.item2_desc: Our AI analyzes your database and automatically suggests the best configurations.
speed.item3_desc: Changes reflect immediately in the runtime environment.

integration.title: Where your data. already is.
integration.desc: Don't waste resources on risky migrations. Ultra-modern interface layer over your SQL databases.
integration.item1_desc: Keep using your native Procedures, Triggers, and Views.
integration.item2_desc: Your data never leaves your local infrastructure.
integration.supported_engines: Compatible with the main database engines on the market.
integration.footer_title: Connect Your Database with Total Security
integration.footer_desc: MetaBuilderPRO connects to your existing infrastructure without migrating your data and without exposing network ports. Start your administrative workspace right now.

branding.title: Your Brand. Your Rules.
branding.desc: Total Whitelabel. Each project with its own dynamic visual identity.
branding.item1_desc: Each project injects its own favicon and logo in real-time.
branding.item2_desc: Define specific font families for each brand.
branding.item3_desc: Native support for Light and Dark mode per project.
branding.custom_domain_desc: Offer the system to your clients using your own company URL (e.g., app.yourcompany.com). MetaBuilder PRO runs transparently with dynamic routing and automatic free SSL certificate generation.

zero_trust.title: Architecture. Zero-Trust Bridge.
zero_trust.desc: Connect your cloud interface to your local database without exposing network ports.
zero_trust.item1_desc: Optimized binaries for Windows and Linux. Run where your database is.
zero_trust.item2_desc: The local executable is the only one that has the database password.
zero_trust.item3_desc: WebSockets to ensure minimum latency and fluid experience.
zero_trust.it_item1: Does not require opening inbound ports.
zero_trust.it_item3: Credentials never leave the client's infra.
zero_trust.it_item4: Auditable: SQL commands pass through the local tunnel.

security.title: Unshakeable. Security.
security.desc: Total protection for your customers' data. Choose between multiple authentication strategies and ensure that only those who should, access what they can.
security.auth_desc: Support for BCrypt, MD5, SHA256 and more.
security.item1_desc: All communication between the Runtime and your database is protected by layers of TLS encryption.
security.item2_desc: Integrated tools for managing cookies, terms of use and privacy policies.
security.footer_desc: Implement bank-level security in your systems in just a few clicks.
security.next_gen_desc: Protect your data and your developers' environment with advanced access policies. We implemented native support for biometrics and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
security.passkey_desc: Say goodbye to passwords. Let your users log into the system using FaceID, TouchID, or Windows Hello. A premium, ultra-fast, and phishing-proof experience.
security.mfa_desc: Enterprise-grade security. As a Workspace Owner, you can enforce mandatory MFA for all developers. Guaranteed protection via Google Authenticator or Authy.
security.app_sec_desc: The same engineering that protects your Workspace is available for the applications you generate for your end users. In MetaBuilder Studio, you can enable Passkey or MFA for your end users with just 1 click.

use_cases.desc: Generate CRUD screens, Kanban, Mind Maps, and Calendars dynamically based on SQL relations.

sync_resolution.desc: Never lose your work again. If a database table is renamed or a column is deleted in your legacy database, MetaBuilderPRO resolves all conflicts automatically for you.
sync_resolution.item1_desc: MetaBuilder scans all changes and displays the items that disappeared from the legacy database, allowing you to easily specify which new name that field or table was mapped to.
sync_resolution.item2_desc: By clicking "Apply", the panel searches deeply through forms, grids, dynamic layouts, and even inside the invisible BPM flows, replacing old variable names with their respective new counterparts.
sync_resolution.item3_desc: The replacement process does not damage complex business logic. It ensures the integrity of custom queries, flow triggers, and pre-compiled macros.
sync_resolution.how_magic_happens_desc: Refactoring dozens of screens, forms, joins, and logic now resolved in 3 simple steps.
sync_resolution.step1_desc: Use traditional tools to rename columns or tables in your legacy database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
sync_resolution.step2_desc: Run our CLI connection command. MetaBuilder will notice the absence of the previous field and ask which current field it migrated to.
sync_resolution.step3_desc: Access the Studio Web panel, make the matches through the visual selector, and see your entire panel update in real-time in the blink of an eye.
sync_resolution.footer_title: Ready to speed up your productivity?

source_code.hero_desc: Don't believe in black-box "No-Code". In MetaBuilderPRO, the source code of the app you build belongs to you. Download a clean, documented, and production-ready boilerplate at any time.
source_code.tech_desc: Exported using App Router, TailwindCSS, and strict TypeScript. No proprietary libraries that lock you into the ecosystem.
source_code.block1_desc: Our generator doesn't just create "code that works". It creates code following the standards demanded by big tech companies (like DRY, SOLID, and configured automated tests). The Boilerplate you download serves as a foundation for high-level teams.
source_code.block2_desc: Started building screens via the MetaBuilder visual interface, but complexity increased? No problem. Export the entire source code and continue development in VSCode with your team. Zero lock-in.
source_code.footer_desc: Unlike traditional no-code platforms, you have unrestricted access to every line of generated code. Create your app's infrastructure and intelligence here, and take the code anywhere.

logs.hero_desc: Monitor everything in real time. With support for client-local logging or direct database logging, you have total control over tunnel traffic, BPM executions, and SQL mutations.
logs.tech_desc: Configure custom retention policies, select which log types are stored, and visualize them through a premium interface inside the dashboard.
logs.block1_desc: Choose where you want to write your logs. Save them in a structured table on the client's database for integrated dashboard viewing, or output them to daily rotated local files on the client's server for offline external audits.
logs.block2_desc: Local auditing is processed ultra-fast by the Tunnel CLI binary. Define retention policies to automatically purge old records and keep database query performance fully optimized.
logs.footer_desc: Whether debugging a complex business rule in BPM, monitoring heavy write queries, or auditing final user access, our logging engine provides the transparency required for robust operations.

ai_studio.hero_desc: Build interfaces and business workflows in seconds. Describe the screen you need and the configured AI generates React code perfectly integrated with your database.
ai_studio.section_desc: An advanced generator connected to your database context.
ai_studio.feat1_desc: Describe the business rule in natural language and the AI will interpret database context, models, and relationships to create the perfect UI.
ai_studio.feat2_desc: The generated result is not a mockup. It is functional, optimized, production-ready React.js code with advanced state logic and forms.
ai_studio.feat3_desc: The AI knows exactly how to instantiate our high-performance UI components like advanced DataGrids, selectors, filters, and interactive modals.
ai_studio.feat4_desc: The AI has full visibility into project tables and relationships to ensure the generated use case connects to Supabase/database correctly on the first try.

git_architecture.hero_desc: Develop locally while AI codes in the cloud. Our invisible architecture isolates your work, merges updates automatically, and ensures you never lose a line of code.
git_architecture.sandbox_desc: The sandbox where both worlds meet securely.
git_architecture.section_3branches_desc: MetaBuilder PRO builds an enterprise Git workflow inside your machine, hiding all complex commands from you. Understand Triangulation:
git_architecture.branch_local_desc: This is your project's foundation. All code you typed, configured, and consider stable stays here. It is your normal disk state.
git_architecture.branch_local_desc_bold: The IDE never changes this branch without your explicit approval.
git_architecture.branch_upstream_desc: The untouched vault. The sole role of this branch is to receive raw code generated in Studio Web. When you click Sync, it downloads and stores updates here without touching your active work.
git_architecture.branch_sandbox_desc: The real magic. The IDE copies your Safe Harbor and merges Pure Cloud on top of it inside this sandbox. This is where you preview, test, and make decisions without risk.
git_architecture.pro_code_p1: Unlike "No-Code" platforms that trap you in black-box dashboards with no source access, MetaBuilder PRO generates real Next.js and React applications.
git_architecture.pro_code_p2: You have full access through our built-in IDE to write complex logic and custom components. The branch architecture exists precisely to protect YOUR manual code from AI automations.
git_architecture.control_title: The Final Control is Always Yours
git_architecture.control_desc: After merging in the Sandbox, you have absolute control over your code's destiny. Test locally, edit files, and validate changes. When finished, you have options:
git_architecture.confirm_merge_desc: Everything works! The IDE moves Sandbox code permanently into your Safe Harbor (local).
git_architecture.discard_desc: Did the merge break or you dislike the result? Click discard. The Sandbox is wiped instantly and your code reverts to exactly how it was.
git_architecture.revert_desc: Made changes inside Sandbox and changed your mind? Roll back to any previous state in milliseconds with one click.

ide.hero_desc: Built for Pro Developers. MetaBuilder Desktop IDE provides an unrestricted environment, combining low-code modeling with native machine infrastructure access.
ide.pro_desc: Absolute control over your code and infrastructure.
ide.byoc_desc: Natively inject custom React components. The IDE includes Monaco Editor with real-time syntax highlighting and validation. Code without leaving the platform.
ide.pty_desc: Full shell access directly from the IDE. Run bash or PowerShell commands, database scripts, package managers, and container orchestration alongside your project.
ide.sql_desc: Native console to run raw queries (DDL & DML) against your local database with 0ms network latency. No proxies and no cloud limitations.
ide.eject_desc: Zero vendor lock-in. Generate and download full source code (Next.js / Node.js) for your application ready to deploy anywhere.
ide.infra_desc: Enterprise features embedded into your development environment.

use_cases_page.title: Business Logics.
use_cases_page.desc: See how the engine analyzes your database semantics to instantiate premium, dynamic, and functional interfaces without generating physical files.
use_cases_page.interactive_desc: Select one of the logics below to see how the interface behaves in the Runtime and how data is processed.
use_cases_page.interactive_hint: Click the elements in the Runtime Simulator above to see the logic in action! In some components, you need to click, drag and drop to see it work in practice.
use_cases_page.how_engine_works_title: How does the Metadata Engine process logic?
use_cases_page.how_engine_works_desc: Each use case is modeled in declarative JSON metadata. The Runtime reads the selected logic and rebuilds the behavioral state on the client's frontend.
use_cases_page.semantic_mapping_desc: The assistant analyzes Primary Keys (PK) and Foreign Keys (FK) to structure forms, link Master-Detail tables, and suggest relationships automatically.
use_cases_page.tunnel_transactions_desc: CRUD commands and SQL queries do not hit external servers. The runtime sends TLS 1.3 encrypted instructions processed locally by the CLI Agent.
use_cases_page.whitelabel_runtime_desc: The screen structure adapts instantly to the theme (Light/Dark), logos, typography, and security rules defined in the branding panel of each workspace.
use_cases_page.bottom_cta_title: Ready to create your Use Cases?
use_cases_page.bottom_cta_desc: Open the Studio panel of one of your projects and use the Use Case Builder to build any of the models in minutes.

cadastro.title: Registration Only
cadastro.desc: Direct form for fast data insertion, without showing existing records.
cadastro.what_is: An input-only layout, optimized for public contact forms, lead captures, or user registrations.
cadastro.behavior: The engine ignores listing (Select) operations and focuses entirely on validation rules and instant insertions (Insert).
cadastro.example: Contact us forms, registration landing pages, or customer feedback surveys.
cadastro.components: Dynamic inputs, validation checks, input masks, and a submit action button.

pesquisa.title: Search Only
pesquisa.desc: Interface focused exclusively on data searching and reporting in a read-only fashion.
pesquisa.what_is: A query-focused page for reporting and filtered searches. Action buttons for creating or editing records are disabled.
pesquisa.behavior: The engine runs optimized database reads (Select) and blocks any write/edit actions (Insert/Update/Delete) for security.
pesquisa.example: Tax receipt queries, access history logs, or system audit trailing views.
pesquisa.components: Quick filter pills, global search box, paginated listing grid, and Excel/PDF exporter.

pesquisa_cadastro.title: Search + Registration
pesquisa_cadastro.desc: The standard CRUD flow. Intelligent listing combined with a complete editing form.
pesquisa_cadastro.what_is: The classic admin dashboard: search for existing records and action buttons to create, edit, or delete data.
pesquisa_cadastro.behavior: Complex state management connecting live query filters and dynamic editing forms in a side drawer.
pesquisa_cadastro.example: Customer directory, product catalog, or inventory control.
pesquisa_cadastro.components: Filter bar, sorting grid columns, side Drawer for edit/create forms, and deletion confirmation dialog.

master_detail.title: Master-Detail
master_detail.desc: Advanced relational explorer showing primary records and linked child tables.
master_detail.what_is: A hierarchical view where a main parent record contains several dependent child records (e.g., Invoice and Invoice Items).
master_detail.behavior: Performs nested relationship queries (Joins/sub-selects) and renders child tables in tabs synced via foreign keys.
master_detail.example: Order detail views with bought items, client profiles with linked services, and invoice tabs.
master_detail.components: Dynamic tabs, child record grids, cascade deletion synchronization, and detail card drawers.

kanban.title: Kanban
kanban.desc: A visual card board organized by columns based on stages or statuses.
kanban.what_is: Ideal for workflow tracking and process pipeline visualization in an intuitive graphical layout.
kanban.behavior: Groups data by a status field and updates records in real-time in the database upon drag-and-drop actions.
kanban.example: Sales Funnel (CRM), Task boards (Project Management), or order preparation queues.
kanban.components: Stage columns, customizable metadata cards, and drag-and-drop column handling.

mapa_mental.title: Mind Map
mapa_mental.desc: Tree node chart to visually inspect organizational chart hierarchies.
mapa_mental.what_is: A geometric and interactive way to explore cascading relationships of parent and child records.
mapa_mental.behavior: Processes recursive relational data trees and renders interactive graphs using SVG and clean animations.
mapa_mental.example: Corporate org charts, family trees, or multi-level product categories.
mapa_mental.components: Interactive SVG nodes, expandable/collapsible nodes, tree searching, and dynamic branches.

dashboard.title: Dashboard (BI)
dashboard.desc: Key performance indicators, interactive charts, and business KPIs.
dashboard.what_is: A dynamic visual panel consolidating key business metrics directly from database records.
dashboard.behavior: Executes complex aggregation queries (Group By, Sum, Avg) and populates high-performance visual chart components.
dashboard.example: Monthly revenue dashboard, active servers monitor, or CRM sales pipeline.
dashboard.components: KPI indicator cards with variation percentages, interactive line/bar charts, and date range filters.

agenda.title: Schedule / Calendar
agenda.desc: Schedules, deadlines, appointments, and tasks in a calendar view.
agenda.what_is: A task and event organizer structured into dynamic monthly, weekly, or daily time grids.
agenda.behavior: Synchronizes records with date/time fields in the database, recalculating time blocks and alert notifications.
agenda.example: Doctor appointment schedules, project delivery timelines, or meeting room bookings.
agenda.components: Grid view layouts (Monthly/Weekly/Daily), interactive event cards with drag-and-drop, and new booking dialog.

personalizado.title: Custom (Hybrid)
personalizado.desc: Complete layout control, perfect for custom workflows beyond standards.
personalizado.what_is: For scenarios where the standard isn't enough. Allows combining modules (grids, kanbans, galleries) in multiple tabs and even transforming tabs into dynamic action buttons (modals/drawers).
personalizado.behavior: The engine allows the developer to build a hybrid panel fully adapted to their business rules.
personalizado.example: Screens with varied tabs, or complex menus interconnecting different analytical reports, records and punctual actions in native overlays.
personalizado.components: Master component, N Secondary Tabs of distinct visualizations, Interactive buttons with dynamic modals.

galeria.title: Gallery / Assets
galeria.desc: Media library and attachment file management with preview and download.
galeria.what_is: A viewing and control interface for assets (images, PDFs, documents, videos) linked to database records.
galeria.behavior: Synchronizes file references stored in a bucket (storage) with database records, providing secure download and native previews.
galeria.example: Customer documents center, product images library, or payment receipts gallery.
galeria.components: Asset cards grid with preview, extension/category filters, full-screen image lightbox, and download button.

timeline.title: Timeline / Feed
timeline.desc: Visualize records in a chronological order based on dates.
timeline.what_is: A chronological stream layout ideal for audit logs, activity feeds, or tracking update histories.
timeline.behavior: Dynamically sorts records using a date/timestamp database column and renders them into a vertical feed grouped by dates.
timeline.example: User activity feeds, proposal edit history tracking, or security auditing logs.
timeline.components: Vertical feed with linking line, event nodes styled by action type, reverse chronological ordering, and event search.

gantt.title: Gantt Chart
gantt.desc: Manage schedules and projects with an interactive bar chart.
gantt.what_is: A timeline-based bar chart view to plan schedules, track task progress, and manage project milestones.
gantt.behavior: Maps start dates, end dates, and completion percentages from database records to render dynamic horizontal time bars.
gantt.example: Software development roadmap planning, corporate event schedules, or construction phase planning.
gantt.components: Weekly/monthly timeline grids, drag-resizable task bars, integrated progress indicators, and sidebar task list.

blueprint.title: Flowchart (Blueprint)
blueprint.desc: Map processes and workflows interconnected dynamically.
blueprint.what_is: A diagramming interface to model logic flows, business approvals, or decision-making pipelines.
blueprint.behavior: Inspects transition relations and nodes in the database to render an interactive flowchart connected by directional arrows.
blueprint.example: Commercial proposal approval flows, internal purchase order processes, or support ticket escalation workflows.
blueprint.components: Interactive canvas, custom node cards, smart connector lines, status legends, and quick action triggers.

map.title: Map View (Geospatial)
map.desc: Visualize records using interactive markers and coordinates on the map.
map.what_is: An integrated cartographic view to locate assets, clients, store branches, or vehicles having latitude and longitude fields.
map.behavior: Queries geospatial coordinate columns and dynamically plots georeferenced markers on an interactive map with filtering options.
map.example: Branch distribution maps, real-time field operator locations, or delivery tracking points.
map.components: Interactive map (Leaflet), customized status pins, popup details cards, and region-based search filters.

control_center_page.title: Control Center.
control_center_page.desc: Track and audit engineering productivity in real-time. Monitor Cycle Time, rework rate, active vs. idle dev time, and manage workspaces, billing, and active user licenses.
control_center_page.interactive_desc: Navigate through the Control Center tabs below to simulate how managers track productivity and subscription status.

descriptions.bi: Unified view of your company's vital metrics. Track active licenses, workspaces created, number of projects, and the distribution of use cases by type (Registration, Query, Master-Detail).
descriptions.productivity: The heart of the Center. Full session auditing with an interactive visual timeline, granular tracking of configuration and navigation events, and precise idle time calculations (time gaps) between developer actions in the Studio.
descriptions.subscription: Simplified management of your subscription plan. Check contract values, recurrent renewal cycles (semiannual/yearly), payment methods (Pix/Credit Card), and download payment receipts with a single click.
descriptions.cancel: Interactive whitelabel feedback form. Users can justify their exit through multiple structured cancellation reasons and additional comments before deactivation in Asaas.
descriptions.community: Exclusive networking hub for clients. Connect with Owners and Devs, share insights, exchange experiences in real-time, and expand your connections within the MetaBuilderPRO ecosystem.
descriptions.metavoice: Integrated two-way feedback channel for the client community. Allows submitting new suggestions, voting on features, and sharing comments, enabling real-time roadmap prioritization.
descriptions.iclub: Integrated loyalty and benefits club. Offers automatic and cumulative invoice discounts for active referrals (5% per referral) and free licenses based on volume (e.g., 12 licenses).

auditing.section_desc: Eliminate the lack of visibility into engineering operational tasks. The Productivity tab is a continuous auditing solution that tracks real DEV interactions with the engine to generate precise management metrics.
auditing.card1_desc: The system calculates actual active development time and precisely highlights idle intervals (time gaps) between each action in the Studio.
auditing.card2_desc: Monitor detailed configuration changes: renaming tables and slugs, adding widgets, adding fields to Grid/Filters, and active/inactive layout buttons.
auditing.card3_desc: End-to-end tracking from automatic session initialization (SESSION_START) to finalization and publishing of changes on the Control Center.

strategic.title: Strategic Management via BI Dashboard
strategic.desc: Consolidate infrastructure data and license consumption across all workspaces created for your company or clients into a single management panel.
strategic.card1_desc: Instantly monitor which types of screens are being created (Registration CRUDs, Query/Report screens, and Master-Detail structures) to audit if resources match active licenses.
strategic.card2_desc: Have full control over generated invoices, Pix payment methods, and send structured cancellation logs directly in the panel. Reduce churn by knowing user pain points in real-time.

pillars.title: Control Center Pillars
pillars.desc: Explore in detail each feature integrated into the MetaBuilderPRO management cockpit:
pillars.card1_desc: Monitor your active plan status, check recurrent renewal dates, and manage developer licenses. The center provides easy and transparent invoice receipt downloads for Pix or Card payments.
pillars.card2_desc: We believe in partnerships free of red tape. Customers can cancel their account directly from the panel at any time. A structured form collects valuable feedback to help us improve.
pillars.card3_desc: Submit suggestions for improvements or new features. Ideas that benefit the client community will be developed and implemented at no additional cost. For very specific business requirements, you can contract execution directly with the MetaBuilder PRO Team.
pillars.card4_desc: Exclusive community integrated into the panel. Connect with other Owners and Devs, publish insights, like, and comment on posts in real-time. A networking hub designed for the MetaBuilderPRO ecosystem.
pillars.card5_desc: iClub is our referral and benefits program. Each successful referral generates a lifetime 5% discount on your invoice (as long as the referred user remains active). Accumulate discounts up to 100% or receive extra free licenses!
